page.layout: One column of verse, running down the page; the page number sits at the top right corner. No marginal notes, and nothing printed below the text apart from a few stray marks.

main_text.l: It quum sepulcri Gallia nunc bonis

l.i: Quod nullus imber, non Aquilo impotens,

page.notes: The left edge is cut away, so the opening words of the first lines are fragmentary and uncertain. Line 1 ("pĩcentes") and line 9 ("alite") are doubtful readings. Line 10 "Dictum" is a guess at the first word, which is unclear on the scan. Some italic and roman distinctions in the verse are approximate. The page number 55 at top right is taken as printed.
